messages:
alex (CEO): Heads-up: company all-hands Wednesday 9:00am PT. Quick plan: 1) State of the product (runtime & serving updates) 2) Policy update: external demo approvals + embargo guidance 3) Incident review highlights from last month 4) People Ops: leveling workshops + referral bump 5) Live Q&A. Drop short questions below or add to the Notion form: https://notion.redwood/all-hands/input. Recording will be posted after.

nina (CTO): We'll demo the new kernel-selection optimizer for a 2-min perf snapshot. If your team has a short regression test you want mentioned, paste results (1 line).

maya (VP Product): Launch owners: add 1-line launch status in the "Launch Callouts" page by Tue noon. Marketing + Legal approval required for external demos.

sam (People Ops): Reminder: leveling calibration sessions week of July 22; managers get invites today. Referral policy: bump effective for hires with offer dates on/after Aug 1. Link: https://hr.redwood/policies/leveling.

leo (Eng): Question: will the incident action tracker include owner names and ETA? Trying to sync on workload.

incidents-bot: Inserted postmortem link: https://incidents.redwood/2026-07-autoscaler-race. Action tracker is attached in the doc.

alex (CEO): Yes, action tracker will list owners + target dates. We'll call out any cross-team work.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks for joining. Recording + transcript: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1799991230. Headline takeaways: a) Focus: prioritize runtime cost reductions and hit reliability targets; b) Policy: new external demo approval flow (Marketing + Legal sign-off required) to reduce embargo slips; c) Operational: updated incident playbook and faster postmortem cadence; d) People: leveling calibration workshops + referral bump timeline.

nina (CTO): Technical note: kernel-selection optimizer cut tail latency for medium-length contexts by ~12% on our benchmarks. Perf writeup coming to eng-notes.

maya (VP Product): Launch callouts: Dedicated beta still on track; owners to publish onboarding checklist by Fri. Marketing will release invite cadence next week.

sam (People Ops): Q&A highlights: leveling changes will not change current comp retroactively; referrals apply to FT conversions. We'll publish an FAQ page by EOD Thursday.

leo (Eng): Thanks for clarifying the action tracker format. Rafael (EngOps) will add owners and ETAs to outstanding items by tomorrow.

jen (Marketing): I've posted an internal embargo checklist in #announcements. Do not share screenshots or PR previews externally until we confirm sign-off.

alex (CEO): Action list: 1) Eng: publish perf notes and attach benchmarks. 2) Product + Marketing + Legal: finalize demo approval flow doc and circulate. 3) Ops: ensure postmortem action tracker with owners/ETAs is visible. 4) People Ops: send calendar invites for leveling workshops. Follow-up doc and links will be posted to Notion by Friday. Appreciate the input and questions—if you raised something and didn't hear back, ping me or @sam. :rocket:
